subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The bakery never became large, and the menu stayed short.”?
options: It became a place where people learned how to keep living things alive after taking them home.
Information can change behavior when it is clear, personal, and connected to choices people can actually make.
Changing habits requires systems that make better choices possible, not just good intentions.
But it became popular because people learned that a shop does not need many choices to make a good impression.
